shared_elements: animal rendered in relief against a plain ground
animal with head turned/limbs indicated schematically
justification: The only real correspondence is that each shows a quadruped mammal in profile carved in relief on a plain field, a motif almost any tradition could produce; A additionally includes a projecting row of animal heads, a woven/zigzag band, birds, snakes and small human-like figures that have no counterpart in B. A is a multi-register composition of flat, schematic, linear relief figures, while B is a single isolated, rounded, high-relief crouching beast, so the relationships, arrangement and carving conventions differ substantially.
